superseded.as: v0.5.1: declared gap in canon: torch heat isolation; at most ~387 MW (34 ppm of jet power) reaches the ship during burns.

plant_power.as: kT ACCEPTS dedicated TWIN D-He3 house reactors: 2×50MW net with declared 40kW/kg and 10% minimum each, 75% direct conversion. The 900K canon cryo card scales to existing 1300K design; EXTRA Metric field/control electrical loads 1/2/3/5MW by mode are declared NON-CANON engineering screening, not proof of environmental correction. Reactor failure fallback staged. No whole-ship certification on new hash.

Speed/angle thresholds stay null/UNQUALIFIED, not invented or safety-certified. 10mm bumper pane, vacuum standoff, twin dome concept does NOT certify hypervelocity resistance.

protected_water_draw_order.kT: Protected-water draw order: service tank first; L3 berth shielding and shelter jacket last, refilled first.
protected_water_draw_order.as: Operating water-management doctrine only, not an implemented water-pump controller. Normal protected consumption draws service tank first (24.75t at S5). Emergency-only after service exhaustion may consume other protected stores; maintain armour/berth and storm shielding by drawing L3 water ring/extended wall, 0.229t service return, and shelter jacket last. Refill shield-critical water before general service tank. Beyond service-tank withdrawal, prior G6 minimum is not guaranteed without a new ray screen. 50t protected inventory not changed.
protected_water_draw_order.note: Protect shield zones as long as practicable. Actual crew water routing and any dose consequences are not qualified.
protected_water_draw_order.draw_sensitivity: Full 36×600 S5: 0t withdrawn→42.59g/cm2, 12.375t withdrawn→42.59, 19.750t withdrawn (5t service left)→42.59, 24.750t withdrawn (empty service)→39.04; 1/36 berth points below 40 at empty service. Never claim every intermediate state safe.
protected_water_draw_order.normal_draw_caution: The service tank provides material shielding on some paths: a complete 24.75t service draw fails one berth ray even with L3/shelter tanks full. Holding 5t service passes the sampled G6 screen, but intermediate levels are not globally qualified. Protect ~5t service as provisional conservative operating minimum until a full withdrawal envelope is verified; reserve is physical water, not a new allocation.
